original.note: Frozen plan line 11 states the retained defect: NativeProviders.login ran capabilities twice and aborted before auth login --browser. Lines 12-13 require the three gemini-default failures to be reproduced under inherited account bindings without weakening the expectation.

findings.message: The only production enrollment path still aborts before auth login --browser on a second capabilities probe. start_login already probes at provider_setup.py:368; a successful result is cached at provider_setup.py:102-103 and refresh reuses it. The worker then calls native.login at line 405, and NativeProviders.login unconditionally calls self.capabilities again at provider_native.py:564-566. A timeout raised from that re-probe, or isolated/login false, never reaches auth login --browser at provider_native.py:574. The new regression calls service.native.login directly at tests/test_provider_review_followup.py:730, so probes stays ["grok"] and the transient hook at lines 680-681 (raise NativeError on the second capabilities call) never runs. The inner observe reuse at provider_native.py:567 does not cover this caller.

Cold gemini catalog calls now pass account_env (provider_setup.py:671, steward_engine.py:1259-1261 and 1295), but _cache_identity does not include ANCHOR_PROVIDER_CONNECTION and the gemini root is always profile/.gemini/antigravity-cli (model_policy.py:327-339). switch_cli still calls model_policy.resolve(target) with no env at steward_engine.py:1771, and terminal_session._resolve_model_selection does the same at terminal_session.py:650. Either fills _MEMORY for CAPABILITY_TTL_SECONDS (model_policy.py:23) under the inherited chatgpt-default marker. A later resolve_quality for gemini-default hits that key and does not run agy with the selected account. The new bound-account test clears _MEMORY first at tests/test_provider_review_followup.py:616, so the green gate never sees a cache seeded by those unqualified resolves.

original.note: Frozen plan line 11 requires the retained Grok sign-in to reach auth login --browser when a second capability probe fails transiently; line 16 is the ten-file pytest gate. The inner observe re-probe is gone. The production sign-in route still probes twice.

findings.message: Plan line 11: NativeProviders.login must not abort before auth login --browser on a transient second capability probe. POST /login calls ProviderService.start_login (provider_setup.py:755), which already probes at provider_setup.py:368 via capability(family, True) -> NativeProviders.capabilities. The worker then calls native.login at provider_setup.py:405. login unconditionally calls self.capabilities again at provider_native.py:564 and only afterwards runs auth login --browser at provider_native.py:574. NativeProviders.capabilities does not read ProviderService's capability cache (provider_setup.py:102), so a transient NativeError on that second call — the failure followup_grok_service models when capability_calls.count(family) > 1 (tests/test_provider_review_followup.py:680) — propagates to provider_setup.py:422 and marks the attempt failed with no browser progress. The new regression calls service.native.login directly at tests/test_provider_review_followup.py:730, so probes stays ["grok"] and never executes start_login. Gate 235/235 does not reach the retained finding on the sign-in entry point.
